author: ViceTechnicolour
body:
Hello.

This game is pretty simple: you post a song, and you must rate the person's song above you then post a song that they might like.
If they like house, maybe go from electro house-progressive-bounce-trance, but not drumstep-neurofunk-glitchhop.
Example -- :
Rating: 8/10
Song: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=EJusm7RYGp8



Your turn! I'll start: Blackmill - Friend https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=0zG_lckuzbo
